content:
maria_cs: FYI — several trial enterprise tenants experienced degraded VPC auth and embedding responses during their onboarding flows yesterday evening. Need an outbound interim status + renewal-risk outreach by EOD. Who can draft a customer-safe status + mitigation note?

dan_engineering: I'm on root cause. Preliminary: a KV cache TTL change + burst ingestion caused early token evictions and auth 401s, client retries amplified load. Rolling a targeted rollback/patch now. ETA ~2h. cc @incident_bot

incident_bot: Deploy started by dan_engineering at 2025-03-20T16:12Z — rolling restart across affected gateways.

lena_support: Can we get a prioritized list of affected tenants and their renewal windows? CS needs segmentation for messaging (high-touch vs batch).

maria_cs: Yes — pulling list. Top impacted trials with renewals in next 30 days: Acme Health, BrightBox AI, Lexis Labs, Meridian Analytics, NovaRetail, PrismaDocs, HelixOps, KiteSecurity. Severity flags: Acme/ BrightBox/ Lexis = high.

alex_sales: For renewals <30d, recommend offering 1 month credit + two priority onboarding sessions. Exec escalation for top 3. Need legal/finance ok on credits?

dan_engineering: Draft RCA summary for customer note: A recent KV cache TTL configuration change reduced token lifetime under load. During a high ingestion spike, tokens were evicted prematurely causing auth failures (401s). Retries caused backlog and increased latency for embeddings. Fixes applied: reverted TTL change, increased cache headroom, added auth failure circuit-breaker, and improved surge alerts. Full technical RCA with timelines will follow.

maria_cs: Thanks — I'll draft the interim email. Proposed structure: 1) brief incident summary 2) what we did to fix 3) immediate mitigations we put in place 4) goodwill offer & next steps (full RCA timeline + office hours). Pasting quick draft for review: 

```
Hi <Customer>,

We want to let you know about a service disruption that affected part of our onboarding flows on 2025-03-19. You may have seen authentication errors or slowed embedding responses.

What happened: a configuration change to our token cache combined with a traffic spike caused some tokens to be evicted early, which led to retries and degraded performance for a subset of tenants.

What we did: we reverted the configuration change, rolled a targeted fix, and increased cache capacity. Monitoring indicates traffic has returned to normal.

What we're doing next: a full RCA will be delivered within 3 business days. We'll also host prioritized onboarding sessions and provide a one-month service credit for affected trial customers as a goodwill gesture. Your CSM will reach out to schedule a 1:1.

We apologize for the disruption and are available for any questions.

Sincerely,
The Redwood Customer Success team
```

alex_sales: Draft looks good. Add a line: "we recognize this impacted your ramp/renewal evaluation; we're prioritizing your environment for the next 30 days." Also confirm top-3 exec note wording.

dan_engineering: Confirmed: fix completed at 2025-03-20T16:54Z. Initial telemetry stable. We'll keep elevated monitoring for 48 hours and push an alert if error rate exceeds baseline.

lena_support: I'll start targeted outreach for the 8 tenants, split by severity. Maria — can you add explicit credit language so finance can approve quickly?

maria_cs: Added credit wording: "a one-month credit applied to your next invoice or a refund at your request." Also tagging finance for approval. Alex — please confirm exec escalation for Acme, BrightBox, Lexis.

alex_sales: Confirmed. I'll prepare the exec escalation note and loop in the account execs. Credit approved for these trials.

maria_cs: Plan: send interim status + mitigation + goodwill offer in next 120 minutes. Full RCA doc within 3 business days and a scheduled priority onboarding session within 7 days for impacted accounts. Any objections? React with :thumbsup: to proceed.

dan_engineering: :thumbsup:

lena_support: :thumbsup:

incident_bot: Incident elevated to P2. Next automated update scheduled in 2 hours.
